title: Initial Trade Analysis · Corgi Loaf Baking Co. ↔ All Hail King Jesus

analysis.executiveSummary: Corgi Loaf Baking Co. executes a textbook championship consolidation move by packaging Saquon Barkley and Cam Skattebo for elite PPR RB1 D'Andre Swift. This transaction elevates Corgi Loaf's active starting-eight C-AVI from 557.0 to 579.8 (+22.8 net gain), securing a locked-in workhorse to pair with Rhamondre Stevenson while sliding David Montgomery into FLEX. For All Hail King Jesus (Retool goal), receiving two starting-caliber RBs erases a glaring void at RB2 and accumulates +78.3 D-AVI in total dynasty asset equity, making acceptance highly likely (94% probability).
